onboarding.title: Set up {project}
onboarding.lead: Studio runs inside the project it was launched in. Check the chat agent, check the model keys your workflows need, then open a workflow.

agent.title: Chat agent
agent.description: The chat runs the agent on this computer with your own subscription. Studio never reads or stores your credentials.
agent.backendLoadFailed: Could not load the selected agent
agent.selectHint: New threads use this agent. Existing Claude and Codex threads stay in this project.

providers.title: Model keys
providers.description: Workflow nodes call models with these keys. A key comes from the process environment, or from the .env file of this project.
providers.missingNote: No model key resolves yet. Export the environment variable, or add it to the .env file of this project.

secrets.title: Project secrets
secrets.description: Tools, MCP servers and providers of this project read these secrets by name. A secret that does not resolve fails the run with SECRET_MISSING.

workflow.title: Workflows
workflow.description: Open one to keep working on it.
workflow.emptyHint: A workflow is a flow.yaml file under the flows folder of this project. Ask the chat agent to draft the first one.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Settings of this project and of Studio on this computer.

project.title: Project
project.description: Studio serves the project it was launched in. To work on another project, run the same command in its folder.

mcp.serverDescription: External agents get the same tools as the Studio chat. The HTTP endpoint needs this launch's token, so agents connect through aqven mcp, which reads it or starts the server in the background.
mcp.claudeCodeHint: Run once in the folder you start Claude Code from.
mcp.stdio: Cursor, Claude Desktop and other stdio clients
mcp.stdioHint: Add this server to the MCP config of the client.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Studio ships inside the aqven package of the environment of this project.
